**RUSE Studio, a preview for modders.** Browse the game's units in any of its ten languages, change their numbers in a
mod of your own, and test it in the game. Your Steam install is never changed.

**0.4.1:** a price is one box that changes all five of a unit's prices (one per battle date); "set each" shows
them one by one. In 0.4.0, changing only the first box left the price unchanged in battles on other dates.

**New in 0.4: Maps**, the start of the terrain editor. Every map the game ships, in 3D, with its real ground and the
game's own ground textures (made once per map, about half a minute, then instant). Drag to turn, right-drag to
move, wheel to zoom. The 3D view needs the internet the first time it opens.

It's new and has barely been tested outside the developer's PC, so please report anything odd on GitHub Issues.
